entries.en: Fyuu seeks your aid in broadening the culinary horizons of his spawnbrothers.
entries.fr: Fyuu cherche à varier le menu servi à ses petits frères.
entries.ja: ノォヴの育成地のフュウは、困り事があるようだ。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Concerned that his younger siblings' diet has been restricted to what can be caught in the waters near the nursery, Fyuu requests that you procure some ocean delicacies from somewhat further afield. Borrow an elbst from Pahh to cross the waves, and collect the whitecap clams found on the beach of Moonshade Isle.

entries.en: Fyuu's eyes appear to bulge even further from his head when he beholds the bounty with which you have returned. Judging by his joyful reaction, it may not be long before you find yourself back on an elbst, headed for the sands of Moonshade Isle once more...
entries.fr: Fyuu n'a pas caché sa satisfaction à la vue des délicieux clams que vous lui avez rapportés. À en juger par sa réaction, vous retournerez probablement à l'îlet d'Ombrelune en quête de nourriture dans un avenir pas si lointain...
entries.ja: フュウにを渡した。これで育成地の弟たちも新鮮な貝を食べられると、彼は喜んでいた。フュウの弟たちの健やかな成長のために、食料が必要になった際には協力しよう。
